create_KeypointsDataset: create a KeypointsDataset instance from a JSON or pickle file containing object keypoint annotations
load_db_file: load keypoint annotation data from a JSON or pickle file into the dataset database
get_class_db: parse and group database entries by unique class masks for class-based random sampling
restrict_images: restrict the dataset to a limited number of randomly sampled entries using a fixed numpy seed
bbox_kp_visibility: compute which keypoints fall within a bounding box with a 10% context margin and calculate visibility error
